# Priya Jha

> Marketer and former agency founder based in Vancouver, BC. Co-founded Bloom Media Studio in 2022 and ran it for four years, with clients across India, the US, the UK and Canada. Works on brand growth, account growth, Amazon, performance marketing and B2B demand generation. Client names are kept private.

## Key pages
- [Portfolio](https://priyajha.co/): case studies told halfway, brand and packaging work, how Bloom was run, contact form
- [Lab](https://priyajha.co/lab/): Clearshelf, a tool in progress that checks whether AI assistants understand a Shopify store's products and helps fix it in plain words
- [Blog](https://priyajha.co/blog/): notes on SEO, AI search and growing brands
